purpose: Role-aware Broker App Agentic Workspace bottom-navigation entry that resolves WorkspaceSegment, uses a unified Trader tab boundary, keeps financial status visible in GUI, and exposes Assist only as low-interruption explain, diagnose, suggest, generate, and summarize support.

kyc_approved_no_deposit.rule: KYC approved without active live trading account or activity

active_trader.rule: active live account, position, pending/sample activity, or usage override exists

partner_mode.rule: role === 'partner' and Partner permission/upgrade is approved

interactions: Open primary CTA through explicit GUI route
Open compact action route for the current Trader or Partner segment
Open quiet Assist only as support/explanation route
Switch approved Partner back to Trader mode
Hide disallowed tabs through href null
risk_rules: Assist must not auto-trade, recommend buy/sell direction, submit funding, transfer funds, or send client messages.
All non-Partner Trader segments show Workspace, Markets, Trade, Accounts, Discover, and Dynamic Discover Module as primary bottom tabs.
Trader destination pages and production backend entitlement must still enforce KYC, trading, funding, account-scope, and high-risk action permissions.
Active Trader shows account, margin, position, funding record, and market status visible in GUI before any Assist entry.
Partner Mode requires approved Partner entitlement; potential Partner only receives application, invite, or explanation entries inside Trader workspace.
Commission Wallet must remain separate from Trader trading accounts.
apis: Local ProductSettings and BrokerStore mock state only for MVP.
Production requires identity, KYC, trading account, position, funding, and Partner entitlement services.
rules: Workspace page must consume domain view model and avoid page-local business segmentation logic.
All visible copy must use i18n keys.
All icons must use registered local AppIcon semantic keys.
UI must use registered Screen, Card, StatusPill, ActionButton, AppIcon, Metric-like, and business components with design tokens.
